question: Find the value of cosec θ (1 − cos θ) (cosec θ + cot θ).
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: cosec θ (1 - cos θ) (cosec θ + cot θ)

**Formula used:**

cosec θ = 1 / sin θ

cot θ = cos θ / sin θ

**Calculation:**

cosec θ (1 - cos θ) (cosec θ + cot θ)</p&g
